notes.title: Game Unavailable on Steam
notes.content:
Hello Nanobot Collectors,

We are sorry to announce that Dr. Schplot's Nanobots will no longer be available to purchase for new users on Steam.  But don't worry, if you already own the game, it will continue to work just fine!  And you will still be able to get customer support by contacting support@darkinertia.com.  Also, it will continue to be available for purchase on Android and iOS (through our partner, GameClub).  

Thanks!
